thread:
omar_solutions_engineer: Quick heads up  ACME Pro wants a single-line quote for API + Optimize + Console + Dedicated for a 12-month term. They specifically asked for a blended discount and a clause for usage growth protection.

nina_csm: Customer is in fintech, needs PCI adjacency notes and an ask for audit logs retention in Console. POC target next month.

kevin_account_exec: They've given an expected starting ARR of $960k (API heavy). They're pushing for 25% off across the board but appear open to tradeoffs (longer commit, prepay).

sara_salesops: Reminder: standard deal desk policy = up to 15% auto; 15-25% require finance + salesops; 25%+ route to CRO + legal. For Dedicated we usually charge a reserve + monthly uplift.

omar_solutions_engineer: Tech notes to include in the quote appendix:
- Dedicated uplift: $12k/month for reserved pool (estimated)
- Private control plane/setup: one-time $30k
- Console audit log retention: 1yr included, extended retention add-on priced separately
- Security artifacts: SOC2, infra diagrams, pen test summary available

kevin_account_exec: Proposed commercial structure (internal draft):
- 12mo commit, annual prepay option or quarterly invoiced commit
- API committed ARR: $720,000/year (list $840,000) -> 14.3% commit discount
- Optimize: $96,000/year credit pool (list $135,000) -> 29% bundle discount if included in commit
- Console (15 seats): $54,000/year (list $60,000) -> 10% off
- Dedicated reserve: $144,000/year (incl. uplift)
- One-time setup: $30,000
- Effective blended discount: ~19% off list across SKUs

lucas_finance: That blended works but please itemize. Finance will approve 19% if prepay or legal signs off on payment terms. Need to add a true-up / acceleration clause if usage >150% of committed in a quarter.

nina_csm: ACME asked whether Optimize credits expire. We should propose 12-month credit expiration aligned with term.

omar_solutions_engineer: Yes propose: credits valid for contract term. Also include performance SLOs for Dedicated in appendix.

kevin_account_exec: Buyer requested a single "net price" for execs. Per salesops guidance we'll provide a one-line net ARR and attach appendix with line items and discount math.

sara_salesops: I'll open DD ticket and mark as high-touch. Include commercial worksheet + SOW + security checklist. Add special term: "discount floor guaranteed for initial term; upon >150% usage growth pricing subject to renegotiation with 30 days' notice".

dealdesk_bot: Deal desk ticket created: DD-2026-94. Reviewers assigned: salesops, finance, legal. Please upload attachments.

kevin_account_exec: Any objections to offering Optimize at ~30% off when bundled? It's our strategic value-add and helps close.

lucas_finance: 30% OK if offset by commit on API (>=12mo prepay) and if SOW limits any free trial compute. We'll need revenue recognition note for prepay.

omar_solutions_engineer: Also flag that certain security asks (HSM integration, on-prem connectors) might be billable professional services. Call that out.

nina_csm: I'll prepare the POC success criteria and timeline to include in the SOW: 4-week POC, latency targets, sample evals, and data handling sign-off.

kevin_account_exec: Great. Next steps: 1) sara opens DD-2026-94 (done), 2) finance + legal review, 3) share one-line net ARR with buyer with appendix. I'll wait for approval before sending.

sara_salesops: Uploaded worksheet and draft SOW to DD-2026-94. Tagging @legal for payment term review and @security for PCI adjacency notes.

kevin_account_exec: Thanks team. Will hold buyer update until we get deal desk approval. :thumbsup:
